purpose: User-authorized NASDAQ-only replacement for the retired 2026-selected cohort
universe_definition: Official historical Nasdaq-100 company index, sampled at each historical month start; retain every included share class, which can exceed 100 securities. This is the user-authorized fallback and excludes financial companies.
formation: Constituents effective at each month start, conservatively usable only after that membership is known. No within-month addition based on later events. Corporate actions independently disable trading and settle holdings.
security_rule: Retain official share classes; join verified same-security ticker renames to stable study IDs. Never attach a reused ticker to a different company.
history_required: Monthly membership July 2019 through December 2025; prices January 2018 through December 2025; earlier data only warms up features.
folds: Train from max(July 2019, January 1 of test_year minus five years) through the year before validation; prior calendar year validation; next year test. Purge all training/validation labels crossing boundaries. The 2022 fold has 1.5 training years, 2023 has 2.5, 2024 has 3.5, 2025 has four.
early_stopping: Prior validation MSE, same criterion across losses; no test-based epoch or seed selection
primary_portfolio: Equal top 10, long only, no leverage; all five training seeds individually and equal-rank ensemble
secondary_portfolios: Fixed equal top 5 and top 20 sensitivity; no best-K choice from test performance
consistency_outputs: Monthly and annual net returns and benchmark-relative returns
Fraction of months and years outperforming each ETF
Turnover and cost stress at 1x, 2x and 4x
Paired block-bootstrap intervals preserving same-date dependence
selection: Fixed architecture comparisons primary. Any candidate recommendation uses only prior validation excess returns with a declared median-minus-spread score; positive net return and risk constraints required. Predictable losses do not constitute success.
required_engine_work_after_data_review: Dynamic monthly membership applied to training, validation, inference, scaling and correlation groups
Stable issuer/security IDs rather than recycled ticker keys
Inactive/future member padding cannot affect active scores; masked hypergraph edges must be tested
Verified corporate-action and delisting settlement accounting instead of indefinite forward fill
Continuous dated account and matched ETF holding periods across annual fold boundaries
data_gate: Reconciled monthly historical index membership, not historical company-cap ranking
No silently dropped old companies or substituted acquirers
Verified issuer continuity across symbol renames
Complete daily prices while a selected security trades; reviewed IPO warmup exceptions
Verified terminal cash/share consideration for test-period acquisitions
No price rows treated as trades after corporate-action completion
stop_rule: No training until data and engine gates pass. Freeze input hashes, code and protocol before test metrics. Report every declared outcome; no adaptive search for favorable 2022-2025 results.
limitation: 2022-2025 has already been repeatedly examined. Correct historical selection removes one hindsight source but does not make these years fresh confirmation data. Future paper trading/unseen dates remain necessary.

amendment.authority: User explicitly permitted historical official Nasdaq-100 monthly fallback if largest-company market-cap ranking was unavailable.
amendment.reason: Alpha Vantage listing probe works, but quarterly shares have no publication dates and full/adjusted daily prices are premium. Free Tiingo recovers unrecycled delisted histories, but CA resolves to an unrelated ETF; earlier FOX security reuse also needs unrecovered pre-reorganization data.
amendment.training_window_reason: Start July 2019 before inspecting replacement test metrics, to avoid silently dropping inaccessible earlier securities. Evaluation remains 2022-2025.
amendment.data_quality: Research-grade reconstructed index events checked against primary announcements; remaining conflicts must be disclosed and resolved or tested. Retrospectively adjusted public prices are not a licensed as-published database.
amendment.unknown_training_outcomes: Labels spanning unpriced pre-2022 mergers may remain unobserved and excluded from the loss only; signal-time membership and features cannot be deleted because a later target is unavailable. Report counts.
